bottleneck.description: High-revisit sub-meter optical earth-imaging constellation competing in a peer-competitive market with Planet, Maxar, Airbus, and emerging Asian operators.

dependency.key_customers: National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), NGA, US DoD, international defense ministries, Palantir, Esri
dependency.key_suppliers: LeoStella (satellite JV with Thales Alenia), SpaceX/Rocket Lab (launch), Sierra Space (sensors)

editorial.notes: BlackSky operates ~19 Gen-2 satellites with Gen-3 35cm-resolution birds deploying, serving mostly US/allied government customers (97% gov in FY24, 62% US). The competitive set is large and growing: Maxar (legacy hi-res leader), Planet Labs, Airbus Defence & Space, Capella (SAR), ICEYE (SAR), plus Asian entrants Axelspace and Hancom InSpace. Customers routinely multi-source imagery. This mirrors the PL calibration anchor (LOW for earth imaging).
